Name: Custom-Made Greenhouse
Author: Kroptik50
Description:
With Custom Greenhouse, you can configure the farming plots inside your greenhouse to suit your run.


[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download Custom Greenhouse and unzip the folder into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.
[/list][size=4]
[b]Updating:
[/b][/size] ﻿When updating, make sure you delete the old files, but remember to keep your generation string if you're using advanced generation.

[size=4][b]Configuration:[/b][/size]
After you run the game at once, a config file will be generated. This file can be edited by accessing it directly inside the mod folder, or ingame before loading a save if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].

You have two modes to generate the greenhouse, simple and advanced.
Simple mode: In simple mode you just state the width and height of the greenhouse. In this mode, the floor not next to a wall can be directly tilled into dirt, so you can shape your plots however you want.
Suggestion: if you want to go for the regular greenhouse aesthetic, I recommend also getting the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19311]Greenhouse-style Wood Floor Border[/url] mod.

Advanced mode:
[spoiler]
﻿In advanced mode, you use the generation key to create your greenhouse. The generation key is made of "blocks", with each block having the structure "WxH X Y", where W is the width of the plot, H is the height of the plot, X is the number of columns of plots and Y is the number of rows of plots. Blocks are separated by ';'. ﻿Blocks are created in front of the previous one. If you want to move lower, you have to make a block with "newline;". This will make it so the next block is generated under the ones already created. It also adds a water trough between the rows.

﻿For example, the block "5x3 2 4" will generate the following farming plots:

Check the images for another more complex example that shows the default greenhouse.
[/spoiler]


[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
﻿This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.
